caption: The drawing consists of three separate rectangular sections arranged vertically on a plain, slightly beige background. The upper part shows two adjacent line drawings in blue, each within a square frame. The left drawing depicts a pot or vase with two geometric handles and outlines of a large face sketched on its front, characterized by exaggerated eyes, nose, and mouth. The right upper drawing shows only a portion of the same pot or vase, focusing on the arch-like top and handle without facial details. Below these, a larger rectangular section on tan-colored paper dominates the composition; on this section, expressive, curved blue and black brushstrokes depict a large, smiling face with accentuated eyes, arched eyebrows, a pronounced nose, and a curved mouth. Above the face, there is a stamped or printed text that reads "POTTERY WORKS" and some partially legible words below it. The overall color palette includes beige, tan, blue, and black, with the main visual emphasis on the central facial features created with loose, sweeping brushstrokes.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
